logo.label: Logo
logo.description: Upload a custom site logo image to be displayed in the site header.

logoDark.label: Logo Dark Mode
logoDark.description: An alternative logo image with higher contrast optimized for dark mode.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.description: Small icon displayed in the browser tab (recommended 32x32px PNG).

siteCover.label: Site Cover / Social Image
siteCover.description: Default background image for social sharing previews (Open Graph).

primary.label: Primary Color
primary.description: Primary brand color used for main buttons, primary links, and focus borders.

secondary.label: Secondary Color
secondary.description: Secondary accent color used for secondary buttons, subtle borders, and highlights.

accent.label: Accent Color
accent.description: Bright highlight color used for badges, alerts, and special feature tags.

background.label: Background Color
background.description: Background color for the main body of the website.

surface.label: Surface Color
surface.description: Background color for cards, dropdown menus, sidebars, and elevated panels.

text.label: Text Color
text.description: Primary text color for body copy, paragraphs, and headings.

link.label: Link Color
link.description: Color for text links. Links will automatically transition to this color.

bodyFont.label: Body Font
bodyFont.description: Font family used globally for body text, paragraphs, and lists.

headingFont.label: Heading Font
headingFont.description: Font family used specifically for headings and titles (h1 through h6).

baseFontSize.label: Base Font Size
baseFontSize.description: Base font size for the website, determining all relative typography sizing.

lineHeight.label: Line Height
lineHeight.description: Line height spacing for body copy, controlling readable distance between lines.

contentWidth.label: Content Width
contentWidth.description: Maximum width for article reading areas, optimized for readability.

containerWidth.label: Container Width
containerWidth.description: Maximum width of the entire page container, centering the website layout.

sidebarPosition.label: Sidebar Position
sidebarPosition.description: Choose where widget columns appear on content pages, or disable the sidebar entirely.

headerStyle.label: Header Style
headerStyle.description: Visual arrangement of the header, including default, centered, or minimal layout.

footerStyle.label: Footer Style
footerStyle.description: Visual arrangement of the footer, including default, centered, or minimal layout.

showSearch.label: Show Search
showSearch.description: Show or hide the search icon/link in the site header.

showLogo.label: Show Logo
showLogo.description: Show the logo image instead of the text site title in the header.

stickyHeader.label: Sticky Header
stickyHeader.description: Keep the header visible at the top of the window while scrolling down the page.

headerHeight.label: Header Height
headerHeight.description: Set the vertical height of the site header in pixels (e.g., 64px).

footerText.label: Footer Text
footerText.description: Short paragraph or description about your site displayed in the footer.

copyrightText.label: Copyright Text
copyrightText.description: Copyright notice text. Supports dynamic placeholders: {year} and {siteName}.

footerColumns.label: Footer Columns
footerColumns.description: Select how many widget columns are displayed side-by-side in the footer.

desktopMenuStyle.label: Desktop Menu Style
desktopMenuStyle.description: Visual layout style for the primary navigation menu on desktop screens.

mobileMenuStyle.label: Mobile Menu Style
mobileMenuStyle.description: Visual interaction style for mobile viewports, such as a hamburger drawer.

megaMenuEnable.label: Mega Menu
megaMenuEnable.description: Display a multi-column dropdown mega menu for top-level navigation items.

homepageLayout.label: Homepage Layout
homepageLayout.description: Select structural layout for the homepage (Default content, Magazine, or Landing page).

heroEnable.label: Hero Section
heroEnable.description: Display a large welcome banner at the top of the homepage.

heroTitle.label: Hero Title
heroTitle.description: Large catchphrase or welcome title displayed inside the homepage hero banner.

heroDescription.label: Hero Description
heroDescription.description: Secondary introduction text displayed below the hero title.

heroButton.label: Hero Button Text
heroButton.description: Text label for the primary call-to-action button in the hero banner.

heroButtonUrl.label: Hero Button URL
heroButtonUrl.description: Destination URL link when the hero call-to-action button is clicked.

showAuthor.label: Show Author
showAuthor.description: Show or hide the author's name in the metadata block of posts.

showDate.label: Show Date
showDate.description: Show or hide the publication date in the metadata block of posts.

showCategories.label: Show Categories
showCategories.description: Show or hide category labels in the metadata block of posts.

showTags.label: Show Tags
showTags.description: Show or hide tags at the bottom or meta section of posts.

relatedContent.label: Related Content
relatedContent.description: Display a list of related articles at the bottom of post pages.

paginationMode.label: Pagination Mode
paginationMode.description: Choose how additional posts are loaded in content lists: standard Pagination (pages), Load More button, or Infinite Scroll.

postsPerPage.label: Posts Per Page / Load
postsPerPage.description: The maximum number of posts to display per page or load at once.

lazyLoad.label: Lazy Load Images
lazyLoad.description: Enable lazy loading for content images to speed up initial page load.

imageBorderRadius.label: Image Border Radius
imageBorderRadius.description: Set the corner rounding amount for all content images (e.g., 8px).

thumbnailRatio.label: Thumbnail Ratio
thumbnailRatio.description: Select the crop ratio for content list thumbnail images (e.g. 16:9, 4:3).

galleryLayout.label: Gallery Layout
galleryLayout.description: Visual layout for image galleries (Grid, Masonry brick layout, or Carousel).

defaultOgImage.label: Default OG Image
defaultOgImage.description: Default background image for social sharing previews (Open Graph).

defaultTwitterImage.label: Default Twitter Image
defaultTwitterImage.description: Default background image for Twitter sharing preview cards.

socialLinks.label: Social Links
socialLinks.description: Social media profile URLs (one per line, e.g. https://twitter.com/myprofile).

enableDarkMode.label: Enable Dark Mode
enableDarkMode.description: Enable a user-facing toggle or auto theme settings to switch to dark backgrounds.

autoDetectSystem.label: Auto Detect System
autoDetectSystem.description: Detect browser preference and automatically switch color scheme.

darkBackground.label: Dark Mode Background
darkBackground.description: The main background color applied when dark mode is enabled.

darkSurface.label: Dark Mode Surface
darkSurface.description: Card and panel background color applied when dark mode is enabled.

darkText.label: Dark Mode Text
darkText.description: The primary text color applied when dark mode is enabled.

radiusSm.label: Border Radius SM
radiusSm.description: Corner rounding for small interactive elements like badges, tags, and checkboxes.

radiusMd.label: Border Radius MD
radiusMd.description: Corner rounding for medium elements like cards, buttons, and form inputs.

radiusLg.label: Border Radius LG
radiusLg.description: Corner rounding for large sections, banners, modals, and container wrappers.

spacingSm.label: Spacing SM
spacingSm.description: Base padding and margin unit for tight layouts and inner element spacing.

spacingMd.label: Spacing MD
spacingMd.description: Standard padding and margin unit for default spacing between sections.

spacingLg.label: Spacing LG
spacingLg.description: Wide padding and margin unit for page-level section layouts.

shadowSm.label: Shadow SM
shadowSm.description: Subtle elevation shadow for inputs, buttons, and small visual tags.

shadowMd.label: Shadow MD
shadowMd.description: Default elevation shadow for hover states, cards, and dropdown headers.

shadowLg.label: Shadow LG
shadowLg.description: Strong elevation shadow for modals, popups, and floating alerts.

animationSpeed.label: Animation Speed
animationSpeed.description: CSS transition speed for hover states, fades, and interactive motion (e.g., 0.2s).

buttonStyle.label: Button Style
buttonStyle.description: Shape style for buttons, including rounded, pill-shaped, or square borders.

cardStyle.label: Card Style
cardStyle.description: Elevation style for content cards (Shadow, Bordered outlines, or Flat layouts).

formStyle.label: Form Style
formStyle.description: Outline style for input fields (Standard Outlined, Filled backgrounds, or Underlined).

tableStyle.label: Table Style
tableStyle.description: Visual structure for tables (Striped alternating rows, Bordered grids, or Minimalist lines).

highContrast.label: High Contrast
highContrast.description: Force high contrast text colors to comply with accessibility requirements.

largeFontMode.label: Large Font Mode
largeFontMode.description: Increase global font sizes to make reading easier for visually impaired users.

focusIndicator.label: Focus Indicator
focusIndicator.description: Enable prominent focus rings/outlines for keyboard accessibility navigation.

dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.description: Date format displayed on posts and pages (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD or DD MMM YYYY).

timeFormat.label: Time Format
timeFormat.description: Time format displayed on posts and pages (24 Hour format or 12 Hour AM/PM).

rtlSupport.label: RTL Support
rtlSupport.description: Enable full RTL (Right-to-Left) layout support for Arabic, Hebrew, etc.

lazyLoadImages.label: Lazy Load Images
lazyLoadImages.description: Enable lazy loading to speed up page loads by loading images only as they scroll into view.

animationDisable.label: Disable Animations
animationDisable.description: Completely disable all CSS transitions, hover animations, and effects.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce Motion
reduceMotion.description: Disable motion effects if the visitor has enabled reduced-motion settings in their OS.

customCss.label: Custom CSS
customCss.description: Inject custom CSS styling rules directly into the site header. Useful for developers.
